parity_consequence: SQL negative result may not equal OWL negation.
mitigation: Use explicit missingness/status codes only where source distinguishes; document #49 assumptions.

loss_or_mismatch: RDB necessarily materializes an identity row although OWL definition is intentionally minimal/pattern-based.
parity_consequence: Do not interpret table existence as foundational category proof.

parity_consequence: Task parity limited to link retrieval.
mitigation: Preserve source instance semantic_type_id; no one-table RiskSource entity.

loss_or_mismatch: RDB can store assertion but cannot prove causal truth.
parity_consequence: SQL retrieval only; no causal entailment claim.

loss_or_mismatch: RDB view gives convenient owner rows but may hide role anti-rigidity if read alone.
mitigation: Never persist primitive owner FK on risk as canonical truth.

loss_or_mismatch: Current-state convenience views can obscure history and time uncertainty.
mitigation: Store intervals and keep distinct state families.

loss_or_mismatch: A code column is less expressive than ontology subclass/context pattern.
parity_consequence: Task-equivalent for bounded result retrieval, not foundational equivalence.

loss_or_mismatch: Not all PROV-O agent/activity/derivation structures are represented losslessly.
parity_consequence: Some provenance CQs may be partial.
mitigation: Retain activity_iri/agent_iri/derivation_note and original RDF evidence where needed.

loss_or_mismatch: RDB stores local reference cache, not full external ontology semantics.
parity_consequence: Cannot answer external taxonomy inference from SQL alone.
mitigation: Bind owner namespace/id/version; use SPARQL/external source for richer semantics.

loss_or_mismatch: RDB row materialization does not encode possible-world/type semantics.
parity_consequence: Task parity limited to scenario identity/relations.

loss_or_mismatch: Projection may look like a rigid entity class.
parity_consequence: Do not infer control identity independent of context.
mitigation: Link external bearer and activity/protection contexts; document role nature.
